issue.title: flag actioning order is not consistent

comments.author: G-Rath
comments.body:
Trying to dig into this more, it looks like this is happening because "set flags" are stored in a map:

https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/be9a4ba05ccf8e92f34274a5e0c555f2ad09e2b3/command.go#L147-L148

which gets iterated over when running actions:

https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/be9a4ba05ccf8e92f34274a5e0c555f2ad09e2b3/command.go#L583-L585

and of course in Go map ranging is random so that explains this.
